messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock the orchestration checklist for the SI + marketplace joint announcement targeted for 2026-05-12. Who can own MDF gating and partner PR?

mona: I can take MDF gating but need clear spend buckets and a PO by EOD Fri. Can someone confirm budget banding? :thinking_face: 

jordan: Marketplace listing + pricing is on me. Will need final integration artifact (marketplace manifest) from the SI by 5/3.

sam: SI integration playbook update ready v2, but need API key rotation window and staging creds for APAC. Pinged infra yesterday — no blocker yet.

lisa: I can coordinate PR + joint blog. Want partner quotes by 5/1, draft by 5/4. Also prefer a coordinated social cadence (announce, technical blog, customer webinar).

alex: Great — rough checklist below. Keep replies short so we can triage owners.

```
Orchestration checklist (owners)
- SI integration playbook (sam)
- Marketplace listing + pricing + manifest (jordan)
- MDF commit signoff + PO (mona)
- Joint PR + quotes + blog (lisa)
- QBR scorecard update (alex)
- Compliance/legal review (sam -> legal)
- Launch rehearsal + rollback runbook (all)
- APAC staging run + regional routing test (eng-infra)
```

jordan: One caveat — pricing tier needs to reflect reserved vs burst capacity. I'll draft a recommended mapping and a delta table.

mona: MDF gating note: we need partner legal MSA + executed SOW before releasing funds. I'll validate with finance and post the PO template here.

sam: For keys/creds: propose a 1-hour maintenance window on 5/10 for rotate + smoke test in staging. Can we get signoff?

lisa: PR timeline: embargo until 05-12 09:00 PT. We'll do an internal readout 05-11 16:00 PT. Also prepare customer-facing FAQ.

alex: Action items — please ack and add ETA next to your name in this thread. I will compile the runbook and share a master checklist.

mona: Ack — MDF gating owner. ETA: PO template and finance checklist by 2026-04-30 COB.

jordan: Ack — marketplace manifest draft by 2026-05-03, pricing delta table by 2026-04-29.

sam: Ack — SI playbook v2 live by 2026-04-28, staging creds + rotate window confirm by 2026-04-27.

lisa: Ack — PR draft + partner quotes by 2026-05-04, embargo plan linked to this thread.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "SI+Marketplace Launch Rehearsal" 2026-05-05 17:00 UTC — https://calendar.example/ev/2067890123

alex: Thanks. Last two notes: 1) QBR scorecard update — I'll add a launch-ready flag so partners pushed this quarter show in the vendor table. 2) If MDF spend > $50k, we need CRO pre-approval per policy.

jordan: Noted on the $50k threshold. If we go above, we'll surface in next week's partner ops review.

mona: Finance check: if CRO signoff required, we need a revenue forecast and expected ARR uplift in the PO. Will draft a short template.

lisa: I'll assemble the FAQ + PR checklist and tag partners for signoff. Can someone drop the partner logos (SVG) into the shared folder?

sam: Dropping staging manifest link now: https://internal.example/sis/staging-manifest-v2.json — double-check region mapping for APAC.

alex: Perfect. I'll consolidate into a single playbook and hand off to ops for rehearsal notes. If anything slips, we move the announcement by one week — call it in thread.

mona: One more — can we add a post-launch health metric (first 72h) to the scorecard? Success thresholds: <2% error rate, median latency <200ms, and adoption >5% of partner customer base.

jordan: Agree, adding those as release gates.

alex: Closing loop: owners acknowledged. I'll post the master checklist tomorrow and tag legal/finance for explicit signoffs. Thanks all. :rocket:
